capabilities: Publish the active note to a PlanetScale table
Update existing rows matched by note title
Delete the active note from PlanetScale
Configure PlanetScale credentials, database, and table
disambiguation: Not a vault backup tool; the README states it is not intended to back up your vault via PlanetScale.
extras: Notes are identified by title, so renaming a note inserts a new row; table column names for title and content are fixed.
motivation: The README says you can leverage PlanetScale as content storage and Obsidian as your preferred content editor.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push note content into an external PlanetScale database for use as content storage.

relations.evidence: Specialized integration with PlanetScale for easy setup

summary: Sync plugin that publishes, updates, and deletes individual notes in a PlanetScale database table from Obsidian commands.
